fsm_states_link_policy.name: POWER_ON / RESET
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Source idle; waiting for the panel Sink to assert HPD.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: CAPABILITY_READ
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Read DPCD Receiver Capability and the eDP_CONFIGURATION_CAP (ASSR / Fast Link Training / PSR caps) over native AUX.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: PANEL_POWER_ON
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Sequence panel VDD / backlight per the panel power timing.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: LINK_TRAINING
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Fast Link Training (preferred — apply stored settings) or full CR then EQ; fall back FLT -> full -> lower rate/lane on failure.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: ACTIVE
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Stream video as micro-packets / Transfer Units; MSA per frame; set backlight brightness over AUX.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: PSR_ACTIVE
fsm_states_link_policy.description: On a static screen, enter Panel Self Refresh: the panel refreshes from its Remote Frame Buffer (RFB) while the Main Link sleeps and the Source GPU may sleep.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: PSR_EXIT
fsm_states_link_policy.description: On update / IRQ_HPD, re-train (Fast Link Training) and re-transmit — full frame, or PSR2 selective-update region.

fsm_states_link_policy.name: IRQ_HPD
fsm_states_link_policy.description: On a short HPD pulse, re-read status (LANE*_STATUS, PSR_STATUS, Device Service IRQ Vector).

fsm_states_link_policy.name: POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_link_policy.description: Write SET_POWER (D3) in DPCD; Main Link idle; panel / backlight off.

fsm_states_clock_recovery.name: CR_START
fsm_states_clock_recovery.description: Set TRAINING_PATTERN_SET=TPS1; drive initial voltage swing / pre-emphasis on all active lanes.

fsm_states_clock_recovery.name: CR_ADJUST
fsm_states_clock_recovery.description: Read ADJUST_REQUEST per lane; apply requested swing / pre-emphasis; wait the training interval.

fsm_states_clock_recovery.name: CR_CHECK
fsm_states_clock_recovery.description: Read LANE*_STATUS; if all active lanes report CR_DONE proceed to EQ; else adjust or fall back.

fsm_states_channel_eq.name: EQ_CHECK
fsm_states_channel_eq.description: Read LANE*_STATUS + LANE_ALIGN_STATUS_UPDATED; success requires CHANNEL_EQ_DONE + SYMBOL_LOCKED + INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE on all active lanes.

fsm_states_channel_eq.name: EQ_DONE
fsm_states_channel_eq.description: Set TRAINING_PATTERN_SET=0; link is trained, enter ACTIVE.

fsm_states_channel_eq.name: EQ_FALLBACK
fsm_states_channel_eq.description: On failure reduce link rate and/or lane count and restart Clock Recovery.

fsm_states_aux_transaction.name: AUX_REQUEST
fsm_states_aux_transaction.description: Source drives SYNC + START + command[4] + address[20] + length (+ write data).

fsm_states_aux_transaction.name: AUX_REPLY
fsm_states_aux_transaction.description: Panel drives reply command (ACK/NACK/DEFER or I2C_*) + read data.

fsm_states_aux_transaction.name: AUX_RETRY
fsm_states_aux_transaction.description: On NACK/DEFER or timeout, the Source retries.

fsm_hints.trigger: HPD assertion starts CAPABILITY_READ -> PANEL_POWER_ON -> LINK_TRAINING -> ACTIVE. All control rides the AUX channel; the Main Link only carries video once trained. On a static screen the link enters PSR and the panel self-refreshes from the RFB.
fsm_hints.rule: Link training prefers Fast Link Training for the fixed embedded channel; full training is strictly CR (TPS1) before EQ (TPS2/3/4). PSR exit re-establishes the link before re-transmitting.
fsm_hints.abort: FLT failure falls back to full CR/EQ; repeated CR/EQ failure falls back to a lower rate and/or fewer lanes.

anti_deadlock_rule: AUX transactions are half-duplex request/reply with retry on NACK/DEFER/timeout, so the bus cannot lock up; link training has a bounded loop-count before fallback; PSR entry/exit is bounded by the frame interval. There is no MST time-slot arbitration in eDP.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on the Source waits for HPD, reads DPCD capability and the eDP_CONFIGURATION_CAP, sequences panel power, trains the Main Link (Fast Link Training preferred, else full CR/EQ with fallback), and enters ACTIVE to stream video; on a static screen it enters PSR.

default_ready_state_recommendation.main_link_idle: Blanking / idle symbols before training; quiescent during PSR self-refresh.
default_ready_state_recommendation.aux_idle: AUX bus released (half-duplex), ready for the next request.
default_ready_state_recommendation.hpd: Panel keeps HPD asserted while present; pulses IRQ_HPD on events.

configurations.name: 1-lane link
configurations.description: Single Main Link lane (ML_Lane0) — low-resolution panel.

configurations.name: 4-lane link
configurations.description: Four Main Link lanes — high-resolution panel.

timing_dependency_rule: The Main Link clock is embedded and recovered per lane during CR (or applied directly in Fast Link Training); multi-lane links are de-skewed during EQ (INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE). The Mvid/Nvid pair lets the panel regenerate the pixel clock; during PSR the panel uses its own timing. AUX runs independently at ~1 Mbps Manchester-II.

fsm_states_fast_link_training.name: FLT_APPLY
fsm_states_fast_link_training.description: Apply previously-stored drive settings (swing / pre-emphasis) and rate/lane configuration for the fixed embedded channel.

fsm_states_fast_link_training.name: FLT_PATTERN
fsm_states_fast_link_training.description: Send the training patterns for a short fixed interval.

fsm_states_fast_link_training.name: FLT_CHECK
fsm_states_fast_link_training.description: Confirm lock; on failure fall back to full CR/EQ link training.

fsm_states_psr.name: PSR_ENTRY
fsm_states_psr.description: Source enables PSR, transmits a final frame, asserts PSR entry, and quiesces the Main Link; panel latches the RFB.

fsm_states_psr.name: PSR_SELF_REFRESH
fsm_states_psr.description: Main Link idle; panel refreshes from the RFB; Source GPU may sleep.

fsm_states_psr.name: PSR_EXIT
fsm_states_psr.description: On update / IRQ_HPD, re-establish the Main Link (Fast Link Training) and re-transmit (full frame, or PSR2 selective-update region).
